questions.scenario: A pharmaceutical clinical trial data collection agent processes adverse patient event reports and submits them to an external regulatory database. Regulatory law requires that an Institutional Review Board (IRB) compliance signature be verified before any submission. Where should this check be implemented?
options: In a PreToolUse hook that checks IRB approval status and returns a deny decision if unverified.
In a PostToolUse hook that parses the regulatory confirmation payload and raises an alert if missing.
Within the coordinator system prompt using bold capital letters warning against unauthorized filings.
In an hourly batch auditing script that identifies unapproved submissions after transmission.

distractors: PostToolUse runs after tool execution, meaning the unverified submission has already been transmitted to regulatory authorities.
Prompt instructions are probabilistic and cannot provide a 100% deterministic compliance guarantee.
Hourly batch audits are post-hoc and fail to prevent unauthorized regulatory filings before they occur.
